note: Measured: the world's complaints per 100,000 successful payments divided by the real-world ratio (config/base_rate.yaml); a lower bound on the true inflation (A-012).
real_world_source: Derived. 2,402,579 NCRP complaints in 2025 (PIB, confirmed) divided by about 228,281.85 million UPI payments (monthly figures from secondary copies, not NPCI's own table) is about 1.05 per 100,000. Complaints cover all financial fraud, so this is an upper-bound proxy for UPI, and the measured factor is a lower bound on the true inflation.
